data: Apple's operating income was $114.3 billion in fiscal 2023 and about $133.1 billion in fiscal 2025, an increase of roughly 16.4%. Fiscal 2025 ended in late September 2025. I'm working from memory rather than a live source, so confirm the fiscal 2025 figure against Apple's 10-K or its fiscal 2025 earnings release before relying on it.
